mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCnt , sum(case when trunc(sysdate) between trunc(fc.cont_bgng_dt) and trunc(fc.cont_end_dt) then 1 else 0 end) as activeCnt , sum(case when trunc(fc.cont_end_dt) - trunc(sysdate) between 0 and 7 then 1 else 0 end) as expiringCnt , sum(case when up.utility_provider_no is not null then 1 else 0 end) as meterCnt from facility_contract fc inner join facility f on fc.facility_no = f.facility_no left outer join utility_provider up on fc.cont_no = up.cont_no where f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo}

select fc.cont_no , fc.cont_nm , fc.cont_end_dt , f.facility_nm , p.partner_nm , trunc(fc.cont_end_dt) - trunc(sysdate) as expire_days from facility_contract fc inner join facility f on fc.facility_no = f.facility_no inner join partner p on fc.partner_no = p.partner_no where f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and trunc(fc.cont_end_dt) - trunc(sysdate) between 0 and 7 order by fc.cont_end_dt asc , fc.cont_no desc

select f.facility_no , f.facility_nm , fac_ty.code_name as facility_ty_nm from facility f left outer join common_code fac_ty on f.facility_ty_cd = fac_ty.code_no_cd and fac_ty.group_code_no = 'FACILITY_TY' where f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} order by f.facility_nm
select p.partner_no , p.partner_nm from partner p where p.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} and nvl(p.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' order by p.partner_nm
select code_no_cd as code , code_name as name from common_code where group_code_no = 'BID_TY' and use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_order
select code_no_cd as code , code_name as name from common_code where group_code_no = 'CONT_STTS' and use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_order
